description: I was glad to join the Malden Fire Department, Mayor Gary Christenson and many others for another promotion and induction ceremony this morning.For those who are new to the force: thank you for joining Malden Fire and stepping up to keep our community safe!For those receiving promotions: thank you for your years of continued commitment and service to this incredible city!

title: Second Firefighter Induction and Promotion Ceremony
